add_paragraph: Arjun did his PhD in the lab between 2016 and 2020, modelling how nutrients move from hillslope soils into the catchment's streams. His ==transport model== is still the one the lab reaches for.
He now works as an Environmental Modeller at Deltares in Utrecht, on flood-risk and water-quality forecasting for river basins across Europe.
He still co-authors with the group — and still answers questions about his old model with more patience than it deserves.
